claim.claim-text: 1. A radio frequency device comprising: an array of filter unit cells formed at least partially in a dielectric material, each filter unit cell includes:
2. The radio frequency device of claim 1, wherein the first ground plane and the metallized layer are electrically connected to one or more conductive structures.
3. The radio frequency device of claim 1, wherein the metallized layer forms a second ground plane.
4. The radio frequency device of claim 1, wherein each filter unit cell further comprises:

5. The radio frequency device of claim 4, wherein each filter unit cell further comprises: a second radio frequency input-output (RF I/O) region located at the fourth opposing surface and electrically isolated from the second ground plane by a second isolation region.
6. The radio frequency device of claim 4, wherein the second ground plane and the metalized layer are electrically connected to the one or more second conductive structures.
7. The radio frequency device of claim 4, wherein each filter unit cell further comprises:

8. The radio frequency device of claim 7, wherein each filter unit cell further comprises: an antenna element located at the sixth opposing surface and electrically isolated from the third ground plane by a third isolation region.
9. The radio frequency device of claim 7, wherein the second ground plane and the third ground plane are electrically connected to the one or more third conductive structures.
10. The radio frequency device of claim 1, wherein the dielectric material is an optically transparent material having a dielectric constant greater than 1.
11. The radio frequency device of claim 1, wherein the dielectric material includes fused silica, quartz, single crystal silicon carbide or single crystal sapphire.
12. The radio frequency device of claim 1, wherein the array of filter unit cells has a quality factor Q greater than 1000 and an insertion loss less than 1 dB.

13. The radio frequency device of claim 1, wherein the one or more conductive structures include one or more conductive side wall layers formed on one or more side walls of one or more cavities defined in the first dielectric layer.
14. The radio frequency device of claim 1, wherein the one or more conductive structures include one or more cavities defined in the first dielectric layer and comprising a conductive material.
15. The radio frequency device of claim 1, wherein the array of filter unit cells includes a millimeter-wave or microwave filter array.
